name: Yellow.ai
tagline: Yellow.ai is an enterprise conversational AI platform for automating customer support across chat, voice, and email channels. Large organizations use it to deploy AI agents that handle tier-one support in multiple languages, with routing to human agents for complex issues. It covers the full support stack from chatbot to live agent to analytics in one platform.
